documents_expected.why: programme page: dates, eligible applicants and projects, match, how to apply
evaluation criteria, including applicant capacity and track record
match funding form submitted with the application

eligibility.rule: Tribes, watershed councils, conservation districts, nonprofits, schools, universities or local governments (not state agencies)
eligibility.quote: Any Tribe, watershed council, soil and water conservation district, not-for-profit corporation, school, Oregon institution of higher education, independent not-for-profit institution of higher education, or political subdivision of this state that is not a state agency.

eligibility.rule: Legally established entity with a federal tax ID (FEIN)
eligibility.quote: OWEB may enter into agreements only with legally established entities.

eligibility.rule: Registered in SAM (with a UEI) before the grant agreement
eligibility.quote: Per federal guidance, all OWEB grantees must be registered at the System for Award Management (SAM) before receiving a grant agreement.

eligibility.rule: Restoration of instream, riparian, upland, wetland or estuarine habitat in Oregon; not maintenance, enforcement or mitigation work
eligibility.quote: A watershed improvement project constructed solely to comply with a state or federal agency enforcement order, legal judgment, or mitigation requirement. Routine project maintenance costs.

eligibility.rule: Applicant's track record and capacity for long-term stewardship are scored
eligibility.quote: What is the applicant’s track record in managing projects,

documents.item: Match Funding Form (cash or in-kind, secured or pending)
documents.quote: Use this form to identify the type(s) of match (cash or in-kind), the status of the match (secured or pending)

documents.item: Signature or letter of support from each secured match source
documents.quote: you must provide either the signature of an authorized representative of the match source in the Match Funding Source Signature/Date column or attach a letter of support from the match funding source

effort.step: Request an OGMS login by email if the organisation has none
effort.quote: If no login exists for an organization, please email Fiscal Staff to request one.

effort.step: Apply in the online application system
Technical review team reads the application and may visit the site
effort.quote: Technical Review Teams (TRT) read applications and may participate in site visits on proposed project sites.

consortium_required.quote: A state agency or federal agency may partner with an eligible entity.

after_award.quote: Refer to the front page and Exhibit B of your grant agreement for report deadlines and format of required progress reports.
alt_quotes: All Project Completion Reporting (PCR) is now done via OWEB's Grant Management System (OGMS).

notes: No maximum request. The page states the match as 25% without saying of what; OWEB's budgeting guidance (GoBIG) defines it, so min_share 25 is read as a share of the project. The match form shows cash or in-kind both count. Offered every summer and winter; the current round closes 1 February 2027. The gather read the page and eight navigation pages but left the evaluation criteria, GoBIG and match form unread; the online-application link lost its colon to an undecoded HTML entity (:).
